description: Fetch nutrient profiles for several foods in one API call. More efficient than calling usda_get_food N times when you already have multiple FDC IDs. Accepts up to 500 IDs: repeats are dropped, the first 20 distinct IDs are fetched, and the rest are returned in deferredIds for a follow-up call. Values are per 100 of each food's basisUnit, with no portion scaling: per 100 g (basisUnit "g"), except Branded foods FDC reports per 100 ml (basisUnit "ml") or per 100 of a label unit that fixes neither (basisUnit absent, basis unverified). Use the nutrients[] filter to limit response size — strongly recommended for batch calls; requested IDs a food does not report are listed in its missingNutrients. For side-by-side comparison with a formatted table, use usda_compare_foods instead. Failed IDs (not found or no data) are reported in the failed[] array rather than aborting the entire batch.

fdcIds.description: FDC IDs to fetch — 2 to 500 entries (a server configured with strict limits rejects more than 20). Repeats are dropped; the first 20 distinct IDs are fetched and the rest are returned in deferredIds. Use usda_search_foods to discover IDs.

nutrients.description: Filter to specific nutrient IDs (e.g. [1003, 1004, 1005, 1008]). Strongly recommended — full profiles can be large. Use usda_list_nutrients to look up IDs. Requested IDs a food does not report are listed in its missingNutrients.

name: usda_get_foods

deferredIds.description: Distinct requested IDs past the first 20, in request order, not fetched by this call — foods and failed cover only the fetched IDs. Pass them to usda_get_foods again, or a single one to usda_get_food. Absent when every distinct ID was fetched.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: IDs that returned no data. Check these with usda_search_foods to verify they exist.

items.description: A failed food fetch with the FDC ID and error reason.

error.description: Why this ID failed — not found, no data returned, etc.

fdcId.description: FDC ID that could not be fetched.

basisUnit.description: What the per-100 nutrient values are measured in: "g" for every non-Branded food and for Branded labels in g/GRM/GM, "ml" for Branded labels in ml/MLT. Absent when the label unit (e.g. IU, MG) fixes neither, so the basis is unverified.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

description.description: Full USDA food name (e.g. "Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, raw").

missingNutrients.description: Requested nutrient IDs this food's profile does not report, deduplicated, in request order. Absent when nutrients[] was omitted or every requested ID is present.

items.description: A nutrient entry with ID, name, amount, and unit.

servingSizeUnit.description: Label serving unit as FDC reports it (e.g. "GRM", "MLT", "IU"); it sets basisUnit. Branded items only.

notice.description: Deferral notice when more than 20 distinct IDs were requested: how many were fetched, and the call that fetches the IDs in deferredIds.

title: Get USDA Foods (Batch)
